scientific_integrity: Generalized amplitude-damping entanglement-breaking criteria and the earlier experimental illustration of rotated amplitude damping are credited; the claim is the complete all-unitary unequal-stage threshold. Literature priority remains subject to independent comparison.
scientific_limitations: The exact theorem concerns two ordered zero-temperature qubit amplitude-damping stages with one arbitrary intermediate unitary, with both survival probabilities strictly between zero and one. Other channels and multiple stages are outside scope.
title: An exact ordered-cascade entanglement-breaking threshold for amplitude-damped qubits
